headline: NEM Insurance 9-Month Profit Jumps 30% on Investment Gains
summary: NEM Insurance Plc reported a 30.5 percent increase in its nine-month profit to 26.77 billion naira for 2026, driven by stronger underwriting results and investment gains.
why: Insurance companies generate significant returns from both underwriting operations and investment portfolios, serving as key barometers for financial sector health in regional African markets.
